biotools.summary: Phylo-Movies is an open-source React and Flask web application, also available as a desktop app, for inspecting ordered phylogenetic tree series. It computes and visualizes subtree-prune-and-regraft transition frames between consecutive trees, helping users see which taxa or subtrees move across sliding-window analyses, bootstrap replicates, and curated tree-series comparisons. The viewer includes timeline playback, tree comparison, MSA context, coloring, analytics, image export, and recording tools.
